ocl.definition: obsUser:User = User.allInstance()->any(u | u.UserID = uid), obsCopy:BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(c | c.Barcode = barcode)
ocl.precondition: obsUser.oclIsUndefined() = false and obsCopy.oclIsUndefined() = false and obsUser.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus[NORMAL] and obsCopy.Status = CopyStatus[AVAILABLE]
ocl.postcondition: let res:Reserve in res.oclIsNew() and res.ReservedUser = obsUser and res.ReservedCopy = obsCopy and Reserve.allInstance()->includes(res) and result = res.oclIsNew()
